title: Evaluating the Health of Open-Source Smart City Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2609.18801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To manage the complexity of smart cities, a variety of smart city platforms (SCPs), both proprietary and open-source, have been proposed. Typically acting as middleware between IoT devices at a lower layer and smart services at a higher layer, these platforms simplify the management of smart cities by reifying a variety of requirements common to different municipalities. Open-source software (OSS) is typically free of charge, making open-source SCPs an attractive option for municipalities with smaller budgets that still wish to improve efficiency and quality of life for residents and visitors. Furthermore, using an OSS SCP promotes digital sovereignty, since municipalities can control where the data will reside and will be less prone to vendor lock-in. translated_title: 评估开源智慧城市平台的健康状况
translated_abstract: 为了管理智慧城市的复杂性，人们提出了各种智慧城市平台（SCP），既包括专有平台也包括开源平台。这些平台通常作为底层物联网设备与上层智慧服务之间的中间件，通过具体化不同城市共同具有的各类需求，简化了智慧城市的管理。开源软件（OSS）通常免费，这使得开源SCP对于预算有限、但仍希望提升居民和访客效率与生活质量的城市而言是一个颇具吸引力的选择。此外，使用开源SCP有助于促进数字主权，因为城市可以自主控制数据的存储位置，并且更不容易陷入供应商锁定。缺乏对OSS的支持阻碍了技术资源往往有限的城市IT团队对其的采用。一个活跃（即“健康”）的生态系统，包括精心协调的开发……
tldr: 本文针对开源智慧城市平台的生态系统健康状况展开评估研究，以帮助技术资源和预算有限的城市判断这些平台是否具有可持续的维护与发展能力，从而促进其在城市中的采纳。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates the health of open-source smart city platform ecosystems to help municipalities with limited budgets and technical resources determine whether these platforms are sustainably maintained and thus worth adopting.
